title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 2,401–2,450 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

examples.en: The tea salon combines modern minimalist decor with traditional aesthetic harmony.
examples.zh: 這間茶館將現代極簡裝潢與傳統審美和諧完美融合。

examples.en: When designing consumer electronics, functionality should complement aesthetic appeal.
examples.zh: 在設計消費性電子產品時，實用機能與外觀美感應當相得益彰。

examples.en: Photographers often develop a distinct visual aesthetic that defines their portfolio.
examples.zh: 攝影師通常會發展出獨樹一幟的視覺審美風格，使其個人作品集更具辨識度。

examples.en: Japanese and Taiwanese interior design share similar natural wooden aesthetics.
examples.zh: 日式與台式室內設計皆共享著相似的自然原木審美觀。

examples.en: The architectural movement challenged established classical aesthetics of the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 這場建築思潮運動挑戰了十九世紀確立的傳統古典審美體系。

examples.en: Courses in film aesthetics teach students how lighting and framing evoke emotion.
examples.zh: 電影美學課程深入指導學生如何巧妙透過燈光與鏡頭構圖勾勒內心情感。

examples.en: The Taipei Fine Arts Museum showcases thought-provoking contemporary art installations.
examples.zh: 台北市立美術館展出了許多發人深省的當代藝術裝置作品。

examples.en: Collectors from around the globe attended the annual contemporary art exposition.
examples.zh: 來自世界各地的藝術收藏家盛裝出席了一年一度的國際當代藝術博覽會。

examples.en: Contemporary art frequently addresses pressing ecological and social justice topics.
examples.zh: 當代藝術作品經常深刻觸及當前迫切的生態環保與社會公平正義議題。

examples.en: Visitors gathered around the abstract modern art oil painting.
examples.zh: 參觀者聚集在抽象現代藝術油畫前仔細品味。

examples.en: The museum's permanent modern art collection includes works by Picasso and Matisse.
examples.zh: 該美術館的常設現代藝術館藏涵查了畢卡索與馬蒂斯等大師名作。

examples.en: She took a weekend workshop to learn the origins of modern art movements.
examples.zh: 她報名參加了週末專題研習班，深入探究現代藝術思潮流派的源流脈絡。

examples.en: The Jadeite Cabbage with Insects is a priceless historic carving masterpiece.
examples.zh: 翠玉白菜是一件舉世無雙、價值連城的古代雕刻名作傑作。

examples.en: Beethoven's Ninth Symphony is celebrated globally as an immortal musical masterpiece.
examples.zh: 貝多芬第九號交響曲被全球公認為永垂不朽的古典交響音樂傑作。

examples.en: Art restorers worked painstakingly to preserve Leonardo da Vinci's painted masterpiece.
examples.zh: 文物修復師嘔心瀝血細緻修復達文西傳世的繪畫不朽傑作。

examples.en: The special Impressionist art exhibition attracted thousands of visitors daily.
examples.zh: 這場印象派特展每天吸引了數千名藝文愛好者前來觀展。

examples.en: A prestigious pottery exhibition will be held in Yingge next month.
examples.zh: 下個月將在鶯歌盛大舉辦一場高規格的國際陶瓷陶藝特展。

examples.en: The natural history museum opened a temporary dinosaur fossil exhibition for children.
examples.zh: 自然史博物館特地為廣大學童開闢了一處為期三個月的恐龍化石常規特展。

examples.en: Local indie painters display their latest watercolor works in Dihua Street galleries.
examples.zh: 本土獨立畫家在迪化街的特色藝廊展出最新的水彩畫作。

examples.en: We strolled through a charming seaside gallery featuring handcrafted glassware.
examples.zh: 我們愜意漫步穿梭於一家陳列手工吹製玻璃藝品的溫馨濱海藝廊。

examples.en: The online photo gallery displays high-resolution pictures of Taiwan's alpine peaks.
examples.zh: 這處線上數位圖片藝廊展示了台灣各大百岳壯麗山巒的高畫質攝影作品。

examples.en: The museum curator carefully selected indigenous weaving artifacts for display.
examples.zh: 博物館策展人悉心挑選了原住民傳統織布工藝品進行特展。

examples.en: An experienced guest curator organized the retrospective exhibition of the late sculptor.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的特邀策展人一手精心策劃了這位已故雕塑大師的生平回顧展。

examples.en: As chief curator, she oversees artifact acquisitions and educational outreach programs.
examples.zh: 作為首席策展人，她統籌負責全館文物典藏收購與公眾教育推廣專案。

examples.en: Ju Ming's Taichi sculpture series represents the harmony of human movement.
examples.zh: 朱銘大師的《太極》系列雕塑作品展現了人體律動的和諧之美。

examples.en: An impressive marble sculpture stood in the center of the fountain courtyard.
examples.zh: 一尊令人嘆為觀止的巨大大理石雕塑巍然矗立在噴水池庭院中央。

examples.en: The art academy trains students in traditional clay modeling and bronze sculpture.
examples.zh: 這所藝術學院悉心培訓學生掌握傳統泥塑成型與青銅雕塑工藝。

examples.en: The skilled wooden sculptor chiseled sacred deity statues with devotion.
examples.zh: 技藝精湛的木雕大師懷抱虔誠敬意精雕細琢神像。

examples.en: The sculptor selected a massive block of Italian Carrara marble for his next piece.
examples.zh: 這位雕塑家為他的下一件大型創作精挑細選了一整塊巨大的義大利卡拉拉白大理石。

examples.en: Many renowned sculptors began their careers making miniature figurines.
examples.zh: 許多舉世聞名的雕塑大師早年皆是從雕刻微型精緻陶俑公仔開始起步的。

examples.en: The museum displayed historical portraits of Taiwanese pioneer artists.
examples.zh: 該美術館展出了多幅台灣早期先驅藝術家的珍貴歷史肖像畫。

examples.en: The photographer took a candid black-and-white portrait of the elderly fisherman.
examples.zh: 攝影師為這位滄桑的老漁夫抓拍了一張神韻生動的黑白人物肖像照片。

examples.en: Switch your phone camera to portrait mode to blur the background naturally.
examples.zh: 將智慧型手機鏡頭切換至人像模式，即可自然呈現夢幻的淺景深背景虛化效果。

examples.en: Chinese landscape paintings convey peace through misty mountain vistas.
examples.zh: 傳統水墨山水畫透過雲霧繚繞的山巒意境傳遞寧靜致遠的意涵。

examples.en: The European landscape painting captured rolling green hills under golden afternoon sunlight.
examples.zh: 這幅歐洲古典風景油畫細膩捕捉了午後金黃陽光灑落在翠綠起伏丘陵上的靜謐。

examples.en: Traditional landscape paintings often include small human figures to emphasize nature's vastness.
examples.zh: 傳統山水風景畫中常巧妙點綴渺小的人物身影，藉以襯托浩瀚大自然的雄偉博大。

examples.en: Writing Chinese calligraphy with brush and black ink trains patience and poise.
examples.zh: 用毛筆與黑墨書寫傳統書法能陶冶性情並磨練沉穩定力。

examples.en: Arabic calligraphy is celebrated globally for its flowing geometric elegance.
examples.zh: 阿拉伯書法以其流暢如行雲流水的幾何線條之美在國際上享有極高聲譽。

examples.en: The Japanese temple features stone tablets carved with ancient zen calligraphy.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的古寺院內隨處可見鐫刻著古老禪宗墨寶的蒼勁石碑。

examples.en: Renowned calligraphers write auspicious spring couplets during New Year.
examples.zh: 知名書法大師在農曆新年期間現場揮毫書寫吉祥春聯。

examples.en: The master calligrapher demonstrated distinct cursive and regular script styles.
examples.zh: 這位書法大師在現場親自向學員示範草書奔放與楷書端莊的筆墨風格差異。

examples.en: An apprentice spent a decade learning stroke balance under the veteran calligrapher.
examples.zh: 這位學徒在老書法名家的門下苦心鑽研了整整十年，方領悟運筆佈局之精要。

examples.en: Yingge Old Street is worldwide famous for delicate ceramics and teapots.
examples.zh: 鶯歌老街以其精緻細膩的陶瓷茶壺與陶藝作品享譽國際。

examples.en: The craft studio offers weekend workshops where travelers can throw ceramics on wheels.
examples.zh: 這間工藝手作坊提供週末體驗課程，讓旅人親手在拉坯機上體驗陶藝創作樂趣。

examples.en: Archaeological excavations uncovered primitive ceramics dating back three millennia.
examples.zh: 考古發掘現場出土了距今三千多年前的新石器時代原始陶器文物。

examples.en: Traditional bamboo weaving handicrafts make eco-friendly household decor.
examples.zh: 傳統竹編手工藝品是既環保又具文化底蘊的優質家居擺設。

examples.en: Indigenous communities sell colorful beaded handicrafts at weekend cultural bazaars.
examples.zh: 原住民族部落在週末文化市集上販售色彩斑斕精巧的手工串珠藝品。

examples.en: She supports fair-trade organizations that empower rural women through local handicrafts.
examples.zh: 她長期身體力行支持公平貿易組織，透過推廣在地手工藝改善偏鄉婦女經濟。

examples.en: Local culinary artisans bake pineapple pastries using pure winter melon and fruit.
examples.zh: 在地糕餅職人堅持使用純冬瓜與新鮮土鳳梨精心烘焙鳳梨酥。

examples.en: Generations of dedicated artisans preserved the complex technique of lacquerware polishing.
examples.zh: 世代傳承的匠人職人堅守並傳承了繁複精微的漆器多道推光打磨技藝。

examples.en: The farmers market featured organic artisan cheeses made from grass-fed goat milk.
examples.zh: 農夫假日市集上展售了由放牧草飼山羊乳精心手工發酵熟成的頂級職人起司。

examples.en: Huashan 1914 Creative Park is a bustling hub for cultural and creative brands.
examples.zh: 華山 1914 文創園區是眾多本土文創品牌齊聚的熱門聚落。

examples.en: The government actively funds youth entrepreneurship in the cultural and creative industries.
examples.zh: 政府當局積極編列專案預算，大力資助青年投入文化創意產業創業圓夢。

examples.en: Souvenirs from cultural and creative markets blend Taiwanese nostalgia with witty humor.
examples.zh: 來自文創市集的伴手禮巧妙融合了濃濃的台灣復古情懷與新世代幽默創意。

examples.en: Reading classical literature fosters deep empathy and refined language sense.
examples.zh: 閱讀經典文學作品能培養深厚的同理心與典雅優美的語感。

examples.en: High school English classes introduce students to world literature masterpieces.
examples.zh: 高中英文課引導莘莘學子深入賞析涉獵世界文學經典代表名篇。

examples.en: Before beginning clinical experiments, researchers conducted a thorough literature review.
examples.zh: 在著手展開臨床醫學實驗前，研究人員先對過往發表的專業文獻做了全面回顧。

words.definition: 文學的；文藝的；愛好讀書的

examples.en: Taiwan Literature Award celebrates exceptional local literary achievements.
examples.zh: 台灣文學獎盛大表彰本土作家傑出卓絕的文藝創作成果。

examples.en: The university town is famous for its lively literary cafes where poets congregate.
examples.zh: 這座人文薈萃的大學城以其隨處可見、詩人齊聚交流的文藝咖啡館而聲名遠播。

examples.en: Her essay contained multiple subtle literary references to Shakespearean tragedies.
examples.zh: 她的散文論述中巧妙穿插了多處向莎士比亞經典悲劇致敬的文學典故。

examples.en: The best-selling mystery novel was adapted into a hit television series.
examples.zh: 這本暢銷推理懸疑小說被成功改編為人氣高收視電視劇。

examples.en: He spent three quiet years in the countryside finishing his debut historical novel.
examples.zh: 他在鄉間幽居了三年漫長歲月，終於完成了自己首部歷史長篇小說處女作。

examples.en: Scientists developed a novel technological approach to recycle lithium-ion batteries.
examples.zh: 科學家們研發出一種新穎前瞻的技術工藝，能高效率回收鋰離子電池原料。

examples.en: Science fiction books explore thrilling possibilities of space exploration and AI.
examples.zh: 科學虛構小說深度探索太空探索與人工智慧的無限可能。

examples.en: The movie is a captivating work of historical fiction based on real maritime events.
examples.zh: 這部電影是一部以真實重大海事歷史為宏大背景的精采歷史虛構影視作品。

examples.en: Don't believe everything you hear on the internet; separate fact from fiction.
examples.zh: 切勿盲信網路上以訛傳訛的謠言，務必保持理性思辨，分清事實真相與虛構杜撰。

examples.en: Biographies and self-help guides fall under the non-fiction book section.
examples.zh: 名人傳記與心靈勵志指南皆歸類於非虛構紀實圖書專區。

examples.en: Readers looking for factual investigative reporting enjoy non-fiction bestsellers.
examples.zh: 偏好真實深度調查報導的廣大讀者群體，普遍熱愛閱讀各類非虛構紀實暢銷書。

examples.en: The author won a major journalism award for her compelling non-fiction expose.
examples.zh: 該名深度調查記者憑藉著其震撼人心的非虛構紀實專著榮獲了重量級新聞大獎。

examples.en: Reciting rhythmic English poetry aloud improves spoken pronunciation and intonation.
examples.zh: 大聲朗誦押韻的英語詩歌能顯著提升口語發音與語調節奏。

examples.en: She expressed grief and long-lost memories through delicate, poignant poetry.
examples.zh: 她將深沉的哀思與久遠的追憶寄託於一篇篇細膩動人的哀傷詩作之中。

examples.en: The rhythm of falling raindrops against the window pane held a gentle poetry.
examples.zh: 窗外淅淅瀝瀝落下的點點雨滴節奏，彷彿蘊含著一股溫柔恬靜的詩意。

examples.en: Taiwanese poet Yu Kwang-chung penned evocative verses on nostalgia.
examples.zh: 台灣已故詩人余光中先生寫下了許多膾炙人口的鄉愁詩篇。

examples.en: Romantic poets celebrated the sublime power and emotional depth of nature.
examples.zh: 浪漫主義詩人熱情歌頌讚美大自然的崇高力量與充沛的情感深度。

examples.en: The young poet recited his verses to a captivated audience in the bookstore.
examples.zh: 這位青年新銳詩人在獨立書店裡向全場聽得如癡如醉的讀者深情朗誦自己的詩句。

examples.en: Her lyrical prose describes everyday life in Tainan with warmth.
examples.zh: 她細膩抒情的散文筆觸溫暖描摹出在台南的市井生活日常。

examples.en: The author's concise, direct prose stands in stark contrast to ornate Victorian novels.
examples.zh: 該作家精準俐落且直截了當的散文文風，與繁複華麗的維多利亞小說形成鮮明對比。

examples.en: Translation requires capturing not only word meaning but also the melodic flow of prose.
examples.zh: 外語文學翻譯不僅要精準傳達字面文意，更需細膩還原散文原本如流水般的音律美感。

examples.en: High school students wrote reflective personal essays on their goals.
examples.zh: 高中生們撰寫了關於個人未來志向的深思心得論述隨筆。

examples.en: The political essay generated heated discussions among academic scholars.
examples.zh: 這篇立論精闢的政治評論短文在國內外學術圈引起了熱烈激盪的思辨交鋒。

examples.en: The fledgling athlete made a brave essay to break the long-standing record.
examples.zh: 這位初生之犢不畏虎的年輕運動員做出了勇敢無畏的初次嘗試，全力衝擊歷史紀錄。

examples.en: The famous author signed copies of her new book at the Taipei Book Fair.
examples.zh: 知名作家在台北國際書展上親切為讀者簽署新書。

examples.en: Who is the author of this insightful editorial on semiconductor manufacturing?
examples.zh: 究竟是哪位專欄作家撰寫了這篇針對半導體晶片製造業極具見地的社論文章？

examples.en: Over her forty-year literary career, the author produced twenty acclaimed novels.
examples.zh: 在長達四十載的文學生涯中，該知名作家累計創作了二十餘部備受讚譽的長篇小說。

examples.en: The talented playwright composed a humorous satire about urban commuting.
examples.zh: 這位才華橫溢的劇作家創作了一齣調侃都市通勤日常的幽默諷刺劇。

examples.en: Shakespeare is regarded by many as the greatest playwright in world history.
examples.zh: 莎士比亞被世人公認為世界文學與戲劇史上最偉大卓絕的傳奇劇作家。

examples.en: Directors collaborate closely with playwrights during early rehearsals to polish lines.
examples.zh: 舞台劇導演在前期排練階段與編劇緊密協同合作，反覆琢磨精雕劇中台詞。

examples.en: We bought front-row tickets to enjoy the Broadway musical at the National Theater.
examples.zh: 我們購買了前排門票前往國家戲劇院欣賞百老匯音樂劇。

examples.en: She majored in theater design and specializes in theatrical stage lighting.
examples.zh: 她在大學專攻劇場設計學系，特別專長於舞台專業燈光視覺氛圍營造。

examples.en: The Mediterranean was a major theater of military conflict during World War II.
examples.zh: 地中海海域在第二次世界大戰爆發期間曾是雙方軍事對峙交火的核心主要戰場戰區。

examples.en: The National Concert Hall features world-class acoustics for classical symphonies.
examples.zh: 國家音樂廳擁有世界一流頂級聲學音響設計，專供交響樂演奏。

examples.en: Thousands of music lovers filled the concert hall for the legendary cellist's recital.
examples.zh: 數千名愛樂聽眾將整座音樂廳擠得水洩不通，只為朝聖傳奇大提琴家的獨奏盛宴。

examples.en: Mobile phones must be set to silent mode before entering the concert hall.
examples.zh: 在邁入莊嚴神聖的音樂大廳前，全體觀眾皆必須將手機設定為靜音模式。

examples.en: The actors stepped onstage with great energy and confidence.
examples.zh: 演員們意氣風發、信心十足地大步登上舞台。

examples.en: The stage lighting illuminated the lead singer as she walked onstage.
examples.zh: 當主唱優雅信步走上舞台時，璀璨耀眼的舞台聚光燈瞬間照亮了她的身影。

examples.en: Performing onstage in front of a live audience cured his childhood shyness.
examples.zh: 登台站在成千上萬的現場觀眾面前演出，徹底治好了他童年時期膽怯害羞的性格。

examples.en: Street performers entertained bustling weekend crowds at Ximending.
examples.zh: 街頭藝人表演者在西門町商圈為熱鬧的週末人潮帶來精彩演出。

examples.en: The circus performer balanced gracefully on a thin tightrope high in the air.
examples.zh: 馬戲團雜技特技表演者在懸空的高空細鋼絲上展現了令人屏息的優雅平衡力。

examples.en: Dedicated performers rehearse tirelessly behind the curtains before every show.
examples.zh: 敬業專業的各類表演者在每一場大戲開鑼前，都在後台幕後不知疲倦地反覆操練。

examples.en: The orchestra held a final dress rehearsal before opening night.
examples.zh: 管弦樂團在正式首演之夜前進行了最後的盛大總彩排。

examples.en: The cast arrived early at the theater for an intensive five-hour technical rehearsal.
examples.zh: 全體演職人員一早便早早趕抵劇院，展開長達五小時高強度的燈光音效技術彩排。

examples.en: Frequent rehearsals helped the young actors overcome their opening-night jitters.
examples.zh: 密集反覆的模擬彩排協助年輕新進演員克服了首演之夜容易產生的臨場怯場焦慮。

examples.en: Dancers rehearsed their synchronized routine for four hours daily.
examples.zh: 舞者們每天進行長達四小時的群舞動作同步排練。

examples.en: He rehearsed his keynote presentation multiple times in front of the mirror.
examples.zh: 他在臥室鏡子前反覆演練排練自己即將上台發表的主題簡報演說。

examples.en: The choir gathered on Saturday morning to rehearse carols for the holiday service.
examples.zh: 合唱團成員在週六清晨齊聚一堂，認真排練即將在聖誕崇拜獻唱的讚美詩篇。

examples.en: The National Symphony Orchestra (NSO) performed Beethoven's Ninth Symphony.
examples.zh: 國家交響樂團（NSO）深情演繹了貝多芬第九號交響曲。

examples.en: Playing violin in a youth orchestra teaches teenagers invaluable teamwork skills.
examples.zh: 在青少年管弦交響樂團中擔任小提琴手，能教導青少年體會寶貴的團隊協調精神。

examples.en: The film's moving soundtrack was recorded live by a sixty-piece European orchestra.
examples.zh: 這部感人電影扣人心弦的配樂原聲帶是由一支六十人編制的歐洲管弦樂團現場錄製。

examples.en: The charismatic orchestra conductor raised the baton and music swelled.
examples.zh: 魅力非凡的樂團指揮家輕輕舉起指揮棒，雄渾樂音隨之奔騰而起。

examples.en: Copper is widely used in electrical cables because it is an excellent conductor.
examples.zh: 金屬銅之所以被廣泛應用於製造電纜導線，是因為它是一種極為優良的導電體。

examples.en: The friendly train conductor punched tickets as the carriage rattled through scenic mountains.
examples.zh: 親切和藹的火車列車長在車廂搖曳穿梭於秀麗青山峽谷時，逐一為旅客驗票剪票。

examples.en: The indigenous children's choir sang heavenly tribal harmony melodies.
examples.zh: 原住民兒童合唱團演唱了如天籟般純淨動人的部落天籟和聲。

examples.en: Joining the church choir on Sundays brought joy and solace to her retirement years.
examples.zh: 週日主日加入教會詩班合唱團獻唱，為她的退休銀髮生活注入了無比喜樂與慰藉。

examples.en: The choir received a thunderous standing ovation at the international choral competition.
examples.zh: 該合唱團在世界合唱奧林匹克大賽中贏得了全場如雷貫耳的起立鼓掌致敬。

examples.en: The Phantom of the Opera is a legendary stage musical loved worldwide.
examples.zh: 《歌劇魅影》是一部風靡全球、傳唱不衰的傳奇經典舞台音樂劇。

examples.en: She was blessed with great musical talent and mastered the piano by age eight.
examples.zh: 她天賦異稟、具備過人的音樂才華，年僅八歲便能游刃有餘地精通鋼琴演奏。

examples.en: London's West End theaters stage internationally acclaimed musicals throughout the year.
examples.zh: 倫敦西區各大知名百年劇院常年輪番上演享譽國際的頂級原創舞台音樂劇。

words.definition: 歌劇；傳統戲曲（如歌仔戲）

examples.en: Taiwanese Opera (Gezai Xi) features expressive singing, colorful costumes, and martial arts.
examples.zh: 台灣歌仔戲融合了抑揚頓挫的唱腔、斑斕戲服與俐落身段。

examples.en: The grand opera house in Sydney is an architectural marvel recognizable worldwide.
examples.zh: 座落於雪梨海港邊的宏偉歌劇院是一座辨識度極高、舉世驚嘆的世界建築奇觀。

examples.en: Classical Italian opera combines theatrical drama with powerful operatic vocals.
examples.zh: 義大利古典美聲歌劇完美揉合了張力十足的戲劇張力與高亢震撼的聲樂唱功。

examples.en: Glove puppetry master Huang Hai-tai preserved folk storytelling traditions.
examples.zh: 掌中戲大師黃海岱先生畢生守護了台灣珍貴的民間說唱敘事傳統。

examples.en: Modern Taiwanese glove puppetry incorporates digital visual effects and rock soundtracks.
examples.zh: 台灣現代霹靂布袋戲大膽融合了前衛的數位 3D 視覺特效與熱血搖滾配樂。

examples.en: Tourists were spellbound by the puppeteer's rapid finger movements during glove puppetry.
examples.zh: 觀光客在觀賞掌中布袋戲演出時，被操偶師出神入化的快手十指身段深深迷住了。

examples.en: Cloud Gate Dance Theatre is an internationally acclaimed modern dance troupe.
examples.zh: 雲門舞集是名揚海內外、享譽國際的台灣現代舞團。

examples.en: The folk dance troupe performed traditional tribal dances at the international festival.
examples.zh: 這支民間民俗舞蹈團在國際藝術嘉年華舞台上深情展演了傳統部落祭典樂舞。

examples.en: Touring with a premier dance troupe requires rigorous athletic stamina and discipline.
examples.zh: 隨同頂尖知名現代舞團展開跨國巡迴公演，需要具備如運動員般極其嚴苛的體魄與自律。

examples.en: Lin Hwai-min is an iconic Taiwanese contemporary dance choreographer.
examples.zh: 林懷民先生是台灣當代現代舞最具代表性的標竿編舞大師。

examples.en: The guest choreographer introduced fluid contemporary movements to the ballet company.
examples.zh: 特聘客座編舞家為這家歷史悠久的芭蕾舞團注入了行雲流水般的當代現代舞語彙。

examples.en: Award-winning choreographers spend months matching steps to complex symphonic rhythms.
examples.zh: 獲獎無數的知名編舞大師耗費數月心血，將每一個舞蹈步伐與交響樂節拍完美契合。

examples.en: The choreography seamlessly blends martial arts movements with ballet grace.
examples.zh: 這套舞蹈編排巧妙融合了東方武術剛勁身段與西方芭蕾的優雅。

examples.en: Music video directors work closely with dancers to polish high-energy pop choreography.
examples.zh: 音樂錄影帶導演與舞者密切配合，反覆打磨流行歌曲熱力四射的齊舞編舞。

examples.en: The figure skater earned maximum technical points for her creative routine choreography.
examples.zh: 花式滑冰選手憑藉著其獨具匠心、極富感染力的節目編舞，奪下了全場最高技術分。

examples.en: The virtuoso pianist received thunderous applause after completing the concerto.
examples.zh: 鋼琴名家在演奏完協奏曲後，全場爆發出如雷貫耳的熱烈掌聲。

examples.en: The audience broke into spontaneous applause as the curtain descended.
examples.zh: 當大紅舞台布幕緩緩降下時，全場熱情觀眾不由自主地爆發出熱烈歡呼與掌聲。

examples.en: Her passionate speech on environmental conservation drew warm applause from delegates.
examples.zh: 她針對生態環境保護所發表的慷慨激昂演說，博得了各國參會代表的熱烈讚賞掌聲。

examples.en: The emotional theatrical performance earned a prolonged standing ovation.
examples.zh: 感人肺腑的精湛戲劇演出贏得了全場觀眾起立鼓掌長久致敬。

examples.en: At the end of the graduation speech, the entire class rose to give a standing ovation.
examples.zh: 在畢業典禮感人演講結束之際，全體應屆畢業生自發肅立，報以經久不息的起立鼓掌。

examples.en: The tenor bowed repeatedly as the audience erupted into a rapturous standing ovation.
examples.zh: 在全體樂迷陷入狂熱起立鼓掌的歡呼聲中，世界著名男高音歌唱家頻頻向觀眾鞠躬致意。

examples.en: Enthusiastic fans chanted 'Encore!' until the rock band returned to play.
examples.zh: 熱情的歌迷不斷高喊「安可！」，直到搖滾樂團重返舞台加演。

examples.en: The violinist prepared two delightful encore pieces to treat the passionate audience.
examples.zh: 這位小提琴名家特地預先準備了兩首輕快精巧的安可加演曲目以回饋熱情樂迷。

examples.en: The stadium exploded in cheers when the superstar walked back out for an unexpected encore.
examples.zh: 當超級巨星出人意料地再度步出後台重返舞台加演安可曲時，整座體育場瞬間沸騰。

examples.en: Misty Taroko mountain peaks provided rich inspiration for the landscape artist.
examples.zh: 雲霧繚繞的太魯閣群山為這位風景畫家提供了源源不絕的藝術靈感。

examples.en: She draws deep culinary inspiration from grandmother's handwritten recipe notebooks.
examples.zh: 她從外祖母泛黃的手寫祖傳食譜筆記中，汲取了無窮無盡的料理烹飪創作靈感。

examples.en: The inventor had a sudden flash of inspiration while soaking in a warm bath.
examples.zh: 這位發明家在舒適泡熱水澡放鬆之際，腦海中忽然如閃電般靈光乍現閃現出絕妙靈感。

examples.en: Hands-on art activities spark children's unbounded imagination and creativity.
examples.zh: 動手做的美術勞作活動能激發孩子們無限的想像力與創造力。

examples.en: Solving intricate engineering challenges requires both technical rigor and boundless creativity.
examples.zh: 破解複雜棘手的工程技術瓶頸，既需要嚴謹的科學推導，亦仰賴無窮的創新創造力。

examples.en: The advertising firm values divergent thinking and boundless artistic creativity.
examples.zh: 這家知名頂尖廣告公司極為重視發散思維與員工源源不絕的原創藝術創造力。

examples.en: Great fiction novelists use vivid imagination to craft entire fantasy universes.
examples.zh: 偉大的虛構小說家運用豐沛生動的想像力構建出瑰麗的奇幻世界。

examples.en: Playing pretend games stimulates a toddler's cognitive growth and active imagination.
examples.zh: 角色扮演假想扮家家酒遊戲能有效刺激幼童的大腦認知發育並豐富其想像力。

examples.en: The visual special effects in the movie were beyond anything our imagination could conceive.
examples.zh: 這部科幻史詩鉅作中所呈現的震撼視覺特效，徹底超越了人類過往的一切想像極限。
